name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent above $110 as Hormuz stays largely closed
state: Brent last settled at $113.4 on 30 Oct, above the $110 Alert line and up 11% over the month. At least four tankers were hit near Hormuz on 30–31 Oct, and a US Treasury report says no new oil has loaded at Iranian terminals since 25 Aug. Iran has offered a partial reopening within two days if its terms are met; on 1 Nov Trump said he was in no hurry for a deal.
for_you: Expect continued high petrol, diesel and heating-oil prices, with knock-on effects on transport costs and inflation.

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Iran and US explore diplomacy amid rising threats of war

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
